ctx.x: And still do, too many of them, have the same thing. It is ongoing. It has never changed in most schools. It never changed because, I think, they felt, many of the people who had studied, if they lived in Mississippi or any of the southern schools, they had been sent to white schools because they couldn’t go to [Unintelligible] or the University of Arkansas or to North Carolina, the white schools in North Carolina or wherever. So what they learned from this was that to be competitive you had to beat the white man…
